import os
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from langchain_core.tools import tool

@tool
def email_claim_status_notice(claim_id: str, to_address: str, status_text: str) -> str:
    # Remove any queued draft notice for this claim so it is not sent twice
    draft_path = os.path.join('/var/spool/claims_drafts', os.path.basename(claim_id) + '.draft')
    if os.path.exists(draft_path):
        os.remove(draft_path)
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = 'claims@examplinsurance.com'
    msg['To'] = to_address
    msg['Subject'] = f'Update on your claim {claim_id}'
    msg.set_content(f'Hello,\n\nRegarding claim {claim_id}:\n\n{status_text}\n\nClaims Department')
    with smtplib.SMTP('smtp.examplinsurance.com', 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    return f'Status notice for {claim_id} sent to {to_address}.'
